# catalystcenter_application (Data Source)

Reads a Catalyst Center application, including built-in NBAR applications. Both `name` and the controller UUID `id` are required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalystcenter_application" "example" {
  id   = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  name = "my-custom-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) The name of the application

### Read-Only

- `application_set_id` (String) Id reference to parent application set
- `indicative_network_identity` (Attributes Set) Indicative signatures used by NBAR applications. Available when reading built-in applications through the data source. Each protocol, ports, lower-port and upper-port combination must be unique. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--indicative_network_identity))
- `network_applications` (Attributes List) Exactly one network application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_applications))
- `network_identity` (Attributes Set) L3/L4 signatures for `_server-ip` applications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_identity))

<a id="nestedatt--indicative_network_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `indicative_network_identity`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_subnet` (Set of String) IPv4 subnets of the indicative signature.
- `ipv6_subnet` (Set of String) IPv6 subnets of the indicative signature.
- `lower_port` (Number) First port in the range, or `0` for discrete ports.
- `ports` (String) Discrete ports, or an empty string when a range is used.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the indicative signature.
- `upper_port` (Number) Last port in the range, or `0` for discrete ports.


<a id="nestedatt--network_applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_applications`

Read-Only:

- `app_protocol` (String) Transport protocol. Omit for `_servername`; use `TCP` for `_url`.
- `application_type` (String) Application type
- `category_id` (String) ID of the application category. Copy this UUID from an existing application in the desired category.
- `dscp` (String) DSCP value assigned to traffic matching this application
- `engine_id` (Number) Engine id, should be set to 6
- `help_string` (String) Description of the application shown in the GUI
- `ignore_conflict` (Boolean) Whether to ignore conflicts with existing application signatures.
- `rank` (Number) Rank used to break ties between overlapping applications
- `server_name` (String) Server name identifying the application, when `server_type` is `_servername`
- `server_type` (String) How the application is identified. `_servername` pairs with `server_name`, `_url` with `url`, and `_server-ip` with `network_identity`.
- `traffic_class` (String) The traffic class the application is assigned to
- `url` (String) URL identifying the application, when `server_type` is `_url`


<a id="nestedatt--network_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_identity`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_subnet` (Set of String) IPv4 subnets matching the application
- `lower_port` (Number) Start of a port range, used with `upper_port`. Leave `ports` empty when a range is used. The controller returns `0` when no range is set.
- `ports` (String) Comma separated list of discrete ports
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the signature
- `upper_port` (Number) End of a port range, used with `lower_port`. Leave `ports` empty when a range is used. The controller returns `0` when no range is set.
